power.answer: ITA Airways accepts up to two power banks per person in hand baggage only, each up to 100 Wh (2 g lithium). Charging and using them on board is prohibited except for approved medical devices, and they may not sit in the overhead locker. For 100 to 160 Wh, ITA issues a transport authorisation arranged at booking.

sections.h: 🔋 What ITA Airways says about power banks
sections.p: From the ITA Airways page "Electronic devices and batteries", read on 22 November 2026.

list: Approval above 100 Wh: tell ITA's Customer Information Assistance Center at booking, or write to prenotazione.assistenza@ita-airways.com; ITA then issues a transport authorisation. Over 160 Wh is not accepted.

faq: How do I get ITA Airways to authorise a bigger power bank?
Notify ITA's Customer Information Assistance Center at booking, or use prenotazione.assistenza@ita-airways.com; ITA issues the authorisation.
Can I charge devices from a power bank on ITA Airways?
No. ITA prohibits charging and using power banks on board, except for approved medical devices.
